OpenRGB version 1.1 has been released as a maintenance update following version 1.0.

This release addresses an issue where the settings checkbox failed to save and ensures the SDK server correctly responds to plugin list requests in headless mode.

Other fixes resolve incorrect device indices in older SDK protocols, CLI resizing and profile loading issues, and hotplug handling improvements across multiple device controllers.
